name: nrp-nautilus
description: Run work on the National Research Platform's Nautilus Kubernetes cluster without hurting it: access and NRP policies, taking your code to a running Job, GPUs, Ceph storage and S3, the managed LLM endpoint, and a preflight check that stops the patterns that overload a shared cluster.

author.name: ddiaz006 (UC San Diego / SDSC, National Research Platform)
